magnitude_pattern: Base damage/utility scales with gem level 1-20; +quality adds secondary effect
stackability: single-instance active; supports stack on top
build_defining_axis: skill identity — which attack/spell you play
genre_lineage: Original to PoE 1; derived from D2 skill trees and D3 rune system

magnitude_pattern: more damage = multiplicative per support; "increased" = additive; each support gem level 1-20; 5 supports at 6-link = 5 stacked multipliers
stackability: multiplicative across "more" supports; additive for "increased" supports; cannot double-up same support
build_defining_axis: damage type / geometry / tempo of primary skill; the 6-link acquisition IS the build-online threshold
genre_lineage: Original to PoE; derived from D2 skill rune concept; no direct precursor

magnitude_pattern: Large two-sided mechanic swap; e.g., CI: life=1 + chaos immunity; Pain Attunement: +30% spell damage at low life; Eldritch Battery: ES protects mana
stackability: single-instance (one per keystone type); does not stack
build_defining_axis: defensive architecture / resource type / damage source modifier
investment_tier_coupling: Mid-game accessible via pathing; some keystones = deep-tree endgame only
genre_lineage: Original to PoE 1; no direct precursor in prior ARPGs

magnitude_pattern: Class-specific major bonus; 2 node pairs selected from 8 available; last pair most powerful (e.g., Chieftain Hinekora: 10% of overkill damage as life gain)
stackability: single-instance (one ascendancy per character)
gating: endgame-gated (4 Labyrinth runs; last pair = Uber Lab)
build_defining_axis: class archetype definition; specific skill/mechanic amplification or unlock
genre_lineage: Derived from D2 character skill trees; PoE original implementation

magnitude_pattern: New passive notables inserted via outer-tree jewel socket; Large=up to 3 notables; Medium=up to 2; Small=1; notables add mechanics unavailable in base tree (e.g., Hollow Palm Technique; Will Shaper)
stackability: additive with existing tree passives; can stack multiple cluster jewels
build_defining_axis: adds mechanics unavailable in base tree; extends passive tree option space
investment_tier_coupling: Mid-game to endgame depending on notable desirability
genre_lineage: Original to PoE (Delirium 3.10); first implementation of "extend the passive tree with items"

magnitude_pattern: Unique jewel; 2-3 mods active only while specific aura is active; e.g., "+X% chance to poison while Despair active"; magnitude varies per roll; compounded RNG (correct mods + correct combination)
stackability: single-instance (one Watcher's Eye); mods are always-on when aura active
gating: endgame-only (specific boss drop + 2-3 mod combo RNG)
build_defining_axis: aura-build specialization; endgame optimization of aura-linked mechanics
genre_lineage: Original to PoE (Elder); derivative of unique jewel concept

magnitude_pattern: Upgraded support; starts stronger than level-20 regular at level 1; max level 5; unlocks additional effect at max level; overrides non-awakened version (no stack)
stackability: single-instance (overrides base; cannot double up)
build_defining_axis: quantitative damage upgrade over regular support; level-5 bonus adds new mechanic
genre_lineage: Derivative of Support Gem system; PoE original upgrade tier

magnitude_pattern: Makes 2-4 leftmost magic utility flasks permanently active; effects cannot be removed; ignores charge consumption for always-on effect; flask effect magnitude boosted by Enkindling Orb (60-70%) without penalty
stackability: single-instance (one belt slot); each flask effect stacks with others
build_defining_axis: converts active-management flask system to passive always-on buffs; build wraps around flask optimization
genre_lineage: Original to PoE 1; ported to PoE 2 in 0.5

magnitude_pattern: On killing rare monster: gain ALL that monster's explicit modifiers for 60 seconds; multiple rare kills stack; unbounded upward scaling per density
stackability: single-instance (one belt slot); stacks per rare monster killed
build_defining_axis: transforms static build into exponentially-scaling-per-kill; creates extreme speed-clear identity
genre_lineage: Original to PoE 1 (Nemesis league 1.1)

magnitude_pattern: Spirit pool (starts 0; grows via bosses and gear); each persistent effect reserves Spirit; reservation is zero-sum trade-off between offense and defense
stackability: single-instance per skill; zero-sum pool constraint
gating: early-campaign (first Spirit gained quickly in Act I)
build_defining_axis: active defense vs active offense trade-off; forces binary choices between persistent effects
investment_tier_coupling: Early-campaign but constrained pool = mid-game decisions
genre_lineage: Original to PoE 2 (replaces PoE1 mana reservation with dedicated resource)

magnitude_pattern: Trigger-based gem; e.g., Cast on Shock fires socketed skills when shock is applied; links multiple skills into a combo chain; Spirit cost for the meta gem
stackability: single-instance per meta gem slot; Spirit-gated
build_defining_axis: skill combo architecture; enables spell-on-hit and reaction-chain builds
genre_lineage: Original to PoE 2; inspired by PoE1 trigger gems (Cast on Crit)

magnitude_pattern: Fixed affix set when correct runes inserted in correct order in normal socketed item; Enigma: +1 Teleport (skill) all classes + 45% MF + high Strength bonus; runes are consumed permanently on insertion
stackability: single-instance (one runeword per item); additive with item base properties
gating: endgame-only (high runes require extensive farming or trade)
build_defining_axis: class identity transformation (Teleport access for all); element viability (Infinity conviction); caster power (Spirit +2 skills + FCR)
genre_lineage: Original to D2 Lord of Destruction (1.10 patch 2003); first implementation of ordered-insertion recipe system

magnitude_pattern: Partial set bonuses (2/3/4/full); Tal Rasha full: +10% to all elemental skills + major MF bonus + attributes; incremental bonuses at each partial set threshold; additive within set bonuses
stackability: incremental per piece; stacking partial bonuses; full set = all bonuses active
build_defining_axis: element/class archetype tuning; MF stacking; FCR optimization
genre_lineage: Original to Diablo 1/D2; derivative of D1 unique item concept extended to multi-piece cohesion

magnitude_pattern: +1 to specific class skill tree; held in inventory (not equipped); takes 1x3 inventory space; multiple skillers stack additively; spatial trade-off (one full inventory = ~5-6 grand charms)
stackability: additive per charm held; stacks with multiple copies; unlimited count up to inventory space
build_defining_axis: quantitative skill-level amplification; spatial optimization game within a game
investment_tier_coupling: Endgame (farming specific skillers with useful suffixes)
genre_lineage: Original to D2 (Lord of Destruction); no direct precursor

magnitude_pattern: 6pc bonus = primary build archetype identity; e.g., Marauder 6pc: all skills deal 12,000% increased damage per active Sentry; scales with sentry count; multiplicative multiplier tied to class mechanic count
stackability: single-instance per set (only one 6pc set active; Ring of Royal Grandeur can reduce requirement by 1)
gating: endgame (seasonal drop; Haedrig's Gift provides set early seasonally)
resource_cost: item acquisition (drops; Haedrig's Gift 1x per season)
build_defining_axis: entire build archetype identity; defines which skills are used; which mechanics matter
investment_tier_coupling: Endgame (or early seasonal via Haedrig's Gift)
genre_lineage: Original to D3 (Reaper of Souls expansion 2014); derivative of D2 set item concept; extended to 12,000% magnitude territory

magnitude_pattern: 3 power slots (weapon / armor / jewelry); each slot = any legendary's unique power extracted; always activates at max potency; cannot equip same power twice; Season 22 adds 4th slot (any type)
stackability: single-instance per slot; 3 simultaneous powers from different categories
gating: endgame (Cube unlocked in Act III; powers require farming specific legendaries)
build_defining_axis: adds 3 legendary effects without using item slots; enables builds impossible via gear alone (e.g., Ring of Royal Grandeur in Cube)
genre_lineage: Original to D3 (Patch 2.3, 2015); first implementation of portable/extractable legendary power system in ARPG genre

magnitude_pattern: Socket into rings/amulet only (3 total slots); primary effect + Rank 25 secondary unlock; upgradeable via GR (upgrade success rate based on tier vs rank); multiplicative at Legendary status; e.g., Bane of Trapped: +15% to CC'd enemies (→60% at rank 150); Legacy of Dreams: +3.75% per legendary equipped (→9750% total)
stackability: single-instance per gem (one copy per character in jewelry); cannot double same gem
gating: mid-game unlock; endgame scaling (rank 25 = new mechanic; rank 150 = max)
build_defining_axis: conditional damage amplification; rank 25 secondary adds new mechanic layer
genre_lineage: Original to D3 (Patch 2.1, 2014); derivative of PoE unique jewel concept; LoD gem = derivative of build-around legendary concept

magnitude_pattern: Orange text on legendary item; power extracted from legendaries to Codex (Season 4+: auto-extract on salvage; Codex stores best roll seen); re-imprinted onto compatible item slot; replaces item's existing legendary affix; scales with item power level; categories: Offensive/Defensive/Resource/Utility/Mobility
stackability: single-instance per item slot (one aspect per item); can have different aspects on different slots
gating: mid-game (Codex dungeon unlocks early; high-tier roll versions = endgame)
resource_cost: Codex aspects: free reuse; extracted aspects: item + materials
build_defining_axis: fundamental skill behavior modification; build identity via which aspect combination is assembled
genre_lineage: Derivative of D3 Kanai's Cube concept; extended to per-slot imprinting system

magnitude_pattern: Socket into Paragon boards (1 per board; up to 5 boards); scales with attribute nodes within radius (radius 3→4→5 as glyph levels); Legendary status at level 51 unlocks multiplicative damage bonus (5.5%[x] at L51 → 15.4%[x] at L150); Fulminate example: +21.1% lightning damage per 5 Dex allocated in range at max
stackability: single-instance per board socket; stacks across boards via different glyph types
gating: endgame (Paragon unlocks at level 70; glyph to Legendary = endgame Pit farming)
build_defining_axis: multiplicative damage multiplier; attribute-node interaction creates contextual scaling optimization
genre_lineage: Original to D4; derivative of D3 Paragon concept; PoE passive tree influence

magnitude_pattern: Add 1 custom affix from Temper Manual category (Offense/Defense/Mobility/Resource/Utility/Weapon) to non-unique gear; 3 reroll attempts per item + 1 more per Greater Affix; affix rolls within magnitude range; can upgrade tempered affix to Greater Affix (+1.5x power)
stackability: single-instance (one tempered affix per item); permanent per attempt (consumes attempt)
reversibility: permanent per item (3-attempt limit; item can be "bricked" with bad affix and no attempts remaining)
build_defining_axis: adds 5th affix to 4-affix item; skill-specific power addition; crafting-layer build customization
genre_lineage: Original to D4 (Season 4 2024 overhaul); no direct prior ARPG equivalent at this specificity

magnitude_pattern: 5 fixed affixes all at maximum roll; universal power floor; e.g., Tyrael's Might: 20% global damage reduction + ~80% resistance + +maximum resistance; The Grandfather: universal critical damage bonus + life + damage; cannot have aspect imprinted
stackability: single-instance (one equipped); best-in-slot for virtually all builds
resource_cost: extreme time investment + Uber boss access
build_defining_axis: defense or offense ceiling lift; near-universal BIS; endgame power plateau
genre_lineage: Derivative of D2 high-tier unique concept; D3 Primal Ancient equivalent; D4 original Mythic tier

magnitude_pattern: 20 skill points per specialization slot; nodes range from flat damage (+15% fire) to transformation nodes (change damage type / add minion behavior / add projectile / enable channeling / alter geometry); full transformation possible within single skill's tree; skill-level items can exceed 20-point cap
stackability: additive per node; node investment is per-point; no global cap beyond 20 (items extend)
gating: early-accessible (first slot at level 4; 5 total slots; full 20 points = level ~75 skill)
build_defining_axis: complete skill behavior transformation: damage type / geometry / resource model / proc behavior / minion interaction
genre_lineage: Original to Last Epoch (Eleventh Hour Games); no direct precursor; LE-original intra-skill tree concept

magnitude_pattern: Permanent upgrade from Monolith boss kill; one affix per boss slot; wide range (power increase to drop rate improvements); persistent globally across all content; irreversible per choice
stackability: additive; stacks across different boss blessings
build_defining_axis: permanent progression layer; minor individual impact; cumulative background power
genre_lineage: Original to Last Epoch; no direct precursor

magnitude_pattern: Inventory grid items (up to 20 slots); shapes vary (1x1 / 2x1 / 1x2 / etc.); affixes include build-enabling rolls; similar to D2 Charms but in a dedicated grid; some idols have exclusive mechanics unavailable elsewhere
stackability: additive per idol; stacks with multiple idols; constrained by grid space
build_defining_axis: flexible minor-amplification layer; some idols are build-enabling for specific mechanics
genre_lineage: Derivative of D2 Charm concept; LE implementation uses dedicated grid vs inventory

magnitude_pattern: Unique items can grant +N to specific skill tree nodes; exceed the 20-node cap; alter skill behavior directly; e.g., items with additional skill tree points in specific node clusters; some uniques enable node paths otherwise inaccessible at normal skill level
stackability: single-instance per item slot; extends skill tree investment beyond normal cap
build_defining_axis: extends or redirects skill specialization tree investments; some uniques unlock otherwise-impossible node combinations
genre_lineage: Original to Last Epoch; interaction with LE skill trees is LE-specific

magnitude_pattern: Two masteries chosen from 9 (36 combinations base; 66 with expansions); each mastery has 26+ skills and modifiers; synergy between masteries is primary build identity; damage type coupling critical (mismatched types = power dilution)
stackability: single-instance (exactly 2 masteries per character)
gating: early-game (second mastery available very early; first mastery at character creation)
build_defining_axis: entire character archetype identity; defines skill access / damage types / synergies permanently
investment_tier_coupling: Early-game decision with permanent endgame consequences
genre_lineage: Original to Titan Quest (2006) which GD's developers created; Grim Dawn is its spiritual successor

magnitude_pattern: 105 constellations; 55 devotion points; 3 tiers (T1 = 1 affinity required; T2 = 8-15; T3 = 22+); terminal node = Celestial Power (proc skill); Celestial Powers ATTACH to a mastery or item skill; proc rate depends on attached skill's attack frequency; experience progression on Celestial Powers
stackability: additive per constellation star; Celestial Power proc = conditional per attachment
build_defining_axis: adds proc-attached secondary attack behaviors; constellation path adds attribute synergies
genre_lineage: Original to Grim Dawn; no direct prior ARPG equivalent for proc-attachment system

magnitude_pattern: 2 class-specific engravings per class (mutually exclusive playstyle splits); e.g., Sorceress Igniter: amplifies Arcane Rupture burst window; Reflux: disables Arcane Rupture entirely + enables steady-damage rotation; stack to level 3 via accessories + ability stones
stackability: single-archetype selection (effectively choose one of two); level 3 = maximum engraving power
build_defining_axis: playstyle archetype split: tempo (burst vs sustained); kit selection; rotation philosophy
genre_lineage: Original to Lost Ark; derivative of class specialization concept in general; Korean ARPG lineage

magnitude_pattern: ~100 non-class engravings; e.g., Grudge: +20% damage to bosses + -20% damage taken; stackable to level 3; most meta builds run 2 class + 3-4 general engravings
stackability: additive level stacks; multiple different engravings stack with each other
build_defining_axis: universal damage/defense amplifiers; conditional mechanics on some engravings
genre_lineage: Korean ARPG convention; derivative of passive buff system

magnitude_pattern: 3 tiers per skill; T1 = minor (speed/meter/cost); T2 = damage/debuff; T3 = significant behavior alteration (e.g., adds AoE / changes hit pattern / adds stagger); transferable between items via Tripod Transfer system
stackability: single-selection per tier per skill (choose one of 3 tripod options per tier)
reversibility: respec-able (select different tripod; high-tier tripod transfer = some cost)
resource_cost: skill point investment; tripod transfer = materials
build_defining_axis: per-skill behavior modification: adds AoE / geometry change / debuff / behavior alteration
genre_lineage: Original to Lost Ark; conceptually derivative of skill rune systems (D3)

magnitude_pattern: 3 concentric rings (inner=3 sections / middle=6 / outer=12); sections color-coded by archetype (red=warrior / green=rogue / purple=mage); rings physically rotate to create alignment between sections; hybridization via rotation; no class-lock; any archetype accessible via ring path
stackability: additive per node allocated; ring rotation is free but alignment determines available nodes
build_defining_axis: class-archetype hybridization; only mechanism for character identity (no separate class system)
genre_lineage: Original to Wolcen; inspired by PoE passive tree but adds physical rotation mechanic; no direct precursor
